scripts.setup: npm run db:up && npm run -w @parentpal/api db:migrate && npm run -w @parentpal/api db:seed
scripts.dev: npm run setup && concurrently -n api,app -c blue,magenta "npm run -w @parentpal/api dev" "npm run -w @parentpal/mobile start"
scripts.dev:web: npm run setup && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run -w @parentpal/api dev" "npm run -w @parentpal/mobile web"
scripts.test: npm run db:up && npm run -w @parentpal/api test
